description: Implementation of WebSocketInflater class for handling zlib-based decompression of WebSocket data streams, including buffer management and inflate operations.

classes.name: ShrinkableIOBufferWithSize
classes.description: A subclass of IOBufferWithSize that allows shrinking the buffer size.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater
classes.description: Handles inflating (decompressing) WebSocket data streams using zlib.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::OutputBuffer
classes.description: Manages output buffer for decompressed data.

classes.name: WebSocketInflater::InputQueue
classes.description: Manages input data queue for inflating.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the inflater with specified window bits.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds data bytes to the inflater for decompression.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Signals the end of data stream for decompression.

methods.name: GetOutput
methods.description: Retrieves decompressed output of specified size.

methods.name: Inflate
methods.description: Performs inflation on input data with specified flush mode.
